persistence: None. Request/input/observation/controller set/view have no Serde or persisted authority admission.
scope: Direct original caller-controller membership for exact existing IC mutation payloads; not complete effect admission.

request.original_plan: Full original intent and operation binding, including context/target/request/allowances
request.wire: Exact closed mutation target/digest must equal original binding
request.challenge: Canonical SHA-256 value; integration owns freshness/uniqueness

controllers.canonicalization: Bounded normalized sorted principals; equivalent duplicates reject
controllers.empty: Known empty set; denies caller control
controllers.unknown: Required qualified provider fails; no default success

observation.evidence: Opaque qualified evidence identifier, not signature/permission
observation.remote_observations: Actual calls, each requiring separate prior approved accounting

admission: Original caller itself in observed controllers

provider_errors.Unavailable: No qualified provider; no remote effects
provider_errors.Unsupported: Cannot meet contract; no remote effects
provider_errors.Indeterminate: Uncertain observation/reply/accounting; retain allowance/evidence and stop; no retry

encoding: 64 canonical lowercase ASCII exact mutation wire-digest bytes

excluded_authority: Public/allowed-viewer status or snapshot read access
integration_obligations: Qualify fresh authenticated actual context/target/complete controllers and challenge timing/uniqueness
No echoed declarations, old receipts or unqualified query responses as current authority
Own coherent custody and prior approved per-call spending; ceiling cannot replenish journals
Load needs separate source/origin control and same-ID safety qualification
qualified_scope: Native local model/policy/port and spent-journal recovery only; no live provider/backend or full preflight.
